_comment: Machine-readable backlog for Token Shield, derived from docs/plan/2026-08-15-LEADERSHIP-WBS.md section 4 rather than invented. Written 2026-08-19 00:35 JST by the overnight session, because bm_idle.py reported NO-DATA for a missing queue file and 'tackle all the backlog' has no defined contents without one. Every item keeps its WBS task id so the two files cannot drift apart silently. States are the four bm_idle.py accepts; stages are the north-star chain stages it accepts, mapped for a measurement product: production-observation for metering surfaces, required-proof and evidence-integrity for the proof machinery, human-decision for surfaces a person reads and acts on, accountability for org and undo, risk for adversarial reviews, release-readiness for integration.
